sample: first 12 frozen free prompts, greedy continuation, three models in shuffled order
reviewer: single assistant reviewer with model labels hidden

fields.contradiction: Explicit inconsistency with opening facts or conflicting roles/objects in the continuation
fields.goal_progress: The opening event or problem is followed or plausibly advanced
fields.coherent_ending: Connected continuation with a coherent ending, without an obvious cutoff

genre: Talking animals and other fictional elements alone are not contradictions
selection: Review is performed after fixed-budget training; no test-based checkpoint selection
